newsitem.title: CHINA: Yacht Britannia casts off from HK harbour.
newsitem.headline: Yacht Britannia casts off from HK harbour.

text.p: The British royal yacht Britannia cast off from Hong Kong early on Tuesday with Prince Charles and the last colonial governor of the territory, Chris Patten, on board.
Britain handed back Hong Kong to China at midnight (1600 GMT) on Monday after 156 years of colonial rule.
Before boarding, Patten and his wife Lavender bade emotional farewells to scores of friends and staff members on the Hong Kong harbour wharf.
They joined the prince on the deck of the yacht to wave goodbye as the vessel pulled away.
